context.description: Validate that both live-check folders still load once ensures is required

evidence.trustReason: Layer-3 review of blend.test.ts describe 'live-check folders' at commit 577275a349 (HEAD e94273b186, no later change to the test, src/task/blend or the two folders; T3.1 schema commit b3f53b66b6 is an ancestor). Run: bun test test/task/blend.test.ts -t live-check -> 7 pass, 0 fail, 65 expect() calls, exit 0. (1) Happy Path COVERED: the load() helper asserts result.failures toEqual [] and dies without a spec; five tests call it for example-scenarios.spec and example-cascade.spec under the HEAD schema where ensures is required (schema.ts:153, no optionalKey); the shape test also asserts every task has an ensures obligation. (2) Invalid Input COVERED, strong: for each folder a scoped temp copy has the ensures block stripped from one leaf VERIFY.md (T1.1-slugify, T1.2-mean); Blend.load must return exactly [{rule:R3, path:<leaf>/VERIFY.md, message:"(root): 'ensures' is a required property"}]. Exact equality: a non-matching regex would give [] and fail; an optional ensures could not produce the required-property message, so the test is mutation-sensitive by construction. Golden folders untouched. (3) Concurrency, Security Boundaries, Timing: N/A per tasks.md. Notes: journal/task/T3.7-verify.md.
